facts.fact: Raxio Data Centre in Namanve, operated by Raxio (general manager Caroline Kamaitha), is operating and hosts the ABQ Cloud sovereign cloud platform, launched there officially on a Thursday reported on 2026-03-04 (the article gives no date for the centre's own opening).

note: Service fact for Raxio; the article says 'globally certified' but gives no Tier rating. ABQ Cloud is a local sovereign cloud, not a global provider region.
